title: validate-filters
intention: The acceptance gate for the VALIDATE brick's output, installed in the build_inspector BEFORE the validate module exists. judge_validate (the pure judge, one implementation) reads the packet's hypothesize_ref berth and holds two claims: VALIDATE_MEASURES_DONE — every criterion carries its claim and its named instrument, missing fields named completely in one finding (done is verified in the world by the instrument, never the narration); VALIDATE_COVERS_THE_BUILD — every criterion's covers entries name pieces the hypothesize berth actually claims, and the union of covers equals that piece set (every piece's done is measured by at least one criterion — the unvalidated piece is the 2026-07-24 piece). The coverage vocabulary COMPOSES THE PREVIOUS GATE'S INVARIANT: a berthed hypothesize covering equals the ranked set (hypothesize-filters enforced it), so this judge reads ONE link with one minimal open — the chain of gates is what lets each judge stay small. The promotion-side mouths ride the one generalized _judge_charted wrapper; the future berth door composes judge_validate by identity, never the reverse.
why: Validate is where 'done' either gets an instrument or stays narration. THE dated failure is the sharpest correction on record: 2026-07-24 done-while-unmoved — DONE was reported from a proxy while the real files stood unmoved, and Akien had already told his boss; the instrument (ls of the actual files) was never run. The success_criteria growth was filed the day the wire landed (packet-inspector-wire edge (a), 2026-07-28: 'no stage emits them yet') — this ticket is that IOU coming due. Coverage closes the same failure's other half: the dropped piece was also the unvalidated piece; a criterion set whose union misses a piece is a build whose wrong landing reds nothing at acceptance.
traces_to: Law 3 — 'done' is a claim; the named instrument is what makes it measured
Law 8 — a hollow build must not be able to pass: criteria cover every piece, and the brick that emits them cannot shape its own acceptance (judges sealed first)
Law 7 — missing fields and uncovered pieces named completely in one finding
Law 4 — verified-on-disk-before-done moves from memory-file discipline into schema physics

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth in build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py — a complete measured criteria set passes quiet; a criterion missing its instrument fires validate_measures_done naming all missing fields; a covers entry on a piece the hypothesize berth does not claim fires validate_covers_the_build with the claimed pieces in evidence; a piece no criterion covers fires the same judge naming every uncovered piece; a broken hypothesize_ref chain is a loud finding; the two-mouths pin. Sealed under the tester before the module exists.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the validate module shaping these judges (the inspector importing from cairn.machines.chart, or the judge defined anywhere but the inspector); the door and the promotion gate disagreeing on one packet; a filter installed here without a dated failure behind it; the coverage check passing a criteria set whose union misses a claimed piece.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the validate module lands under these judges (same arc); when the first real acceptance run executes a criteria set (does the instrument field want structure — command vs gate vs proof-path?); when /sail grows a step that RUNS the criteria at PROVED (the natural next compilation).

questions.a: SIXTH APPLICATION — the ordering is simply how stages land.

COMPOSING THE PREVIOUS GATE'S INVARIANT: the coverage vocabulary is the hypothesize berth's piece set, valid BECAUSE hypothesize-filters enforced covering=ranked — each judge stays one-open minimal by standing on the gate below it, the same move as the chain readers composing by identity, one level up.

VALIDATE vs HYPOTHESIZE: hypothesize claims what each piece will DO (mechanism, killed or confirmed during the build); validate states what DONE means for the request as a WHOLE (acceptance, run at the end), tied to pieces through covers.
